conservative_wording.equivalent: The information-preserving permutation did not change confirmatory accuracy by more than the predeclared margin under this architecture and protocol.
conservative_wording.inconclusive: No practically meaningful effect of the permutation was established under this architecture and protocol; this does not establish that none exists.
conservative_wording.supported: The information-preserving permutation changed confirmatory accuracy materially: the result depends on the tested encoding under this architecture and protocol. It does not show that the ciphertext lacks information recoverable another way.

factors.name: representation
factors.rationale: DBitNet's dilated convolutions relate input positions at fixed distances; if the natural alignment of corresponding bits across the four ciphertext words, rather than information in the ciphertext pair, drives performance, scrambling bit positions within each word should materially reduce accuracy.

practical_significance.justification: The practical-effect margin is one percentage point of absolute held-out accuracy. It follows the audit-wide margin previously adopted for II-4, using the same accuracy metric. This is a prospective methodological judgment, not a universal literature-derived threshold, and is not based on calibration variability or observed EV outcomes.

experiment_definition.rationale: AutoND counterpart of the EV experiment of the same role.
experiment_definition.scientific_claim: Under the fixed DBitNet architecture and round-5 protocol, whether a fixed, information-preserving within-word bit permutation of the input produces a practically meaningful change in confirmatory distinguishing accuracy.
experiment_definition.unit_of_replication: matched pair of independently trained models (shared dataset, model initialization, evaluation data; independent training shuffle stream)

limitations: one training stage at round 5 from a fresh initialisation; upstream's staged multi-round loop (weight transfer between rounds, stopping rule) is not run
outcome is accuracy of the final-epoch model on an independent 10**6-row confirmatory test set; upstream reports max validation accuracy and keeps the min-val_loss checkpoint per round
TensorFlow is seeded per model with tf.keras.utils.set_random_seed (upstream is unseeded); GPU kernels remain nondeterministic and no op-determinism flag is set
datasets are persisted once per replicate/pair and reloaded hash-verified, so both arms of a pair and any resumed unit use the identical data
shuffle is passed explicitly; the baseline value is upstream's model.fit default (True)
a non-significant difference without formal equivalence is INCONCLUSIVE, never evidence of no effect
decisions in a per-experiment certificate are provisional (raw alpha); the final paired decisions come from the AutoND primary-family Holm correction
exact replay is unavailable: datasets come from os.urandom; the persisted arrays are the reference
